title: 理想与商环
Ideals and quotient rings
模：把标量从域推广到环
Modules: scalars from a ring
text: 本拓展重点讨论有单位元的交换环 \(R\)。一个 \(R\)-模是交换群 \((M,+)\)，配上满足左列公理的标量乘法；其中 \(r,s\in R\)，\(m,n\in M\)。元素 \(m\) 不必是数，标量 \(r\) 也不必可逆。

We focus on a commutative ring \(R\) with identity. An \(R\)-module is an abelian group \((M,+)\) with scalar multiplication satisfying the displayed axioms, for \(r,s\in R\) and \(m,n\in M\). Elements of \(M\) need not be numbers, and scalars need not be invertible.
example: \(R^n\) 的加法与标量乘法逐分量定义，从而成为 \(R\)-模；\(R\) 本身也通过环乘法成为 \(R\)-模。这里不要求给 \(M\) 中任意两个元素定义乘积。
Componentwise operations make \(R^n\) an \(R\)-module; multiplication in \(R\) makes \(R\) itself a module. A module does not require a product of two arbitrary elements of \(M\).
warning: 非交换环只作定义说明：对有单位元、未必交换的 \(R\)，上述公理定义左 \(R\)-模。右模改用 \(M\times R\to M\)，满足 \((m+n)r=mr+nr\)、\(m(r+s)=mr+ms\)、\((mr)s=m(rs)\)、\(m1=m\)。交换时可令 \(mr=rm\)，不再区分左右。教材允许环没有单位元；若采用无单位元环上的模定义，则删去单位公理，其余不变。下文默认交换且有单位元。

For a possibly noncommutative unital ring, the same axioms define a left module. A right module uses \(M\times R\to M\), with \((m+n)r=mr+nr\), \(m(r+s)=mr+ms\), \((mr)s=m(rs)\), and \(m1=m\). For commutative rings, put \(mr=rm\) to identify the two conventions. The textbook also allows rings without identity; modules over such rings omit the unit axiom. Below, rings are commutative and unital.

title: 线性空间就是域上的模
Vector spaces are modules over fields
text: 把标量环 \(R\) 取为域 \(F\)，模的公理恰好就是线性空间的公理。模保留了加法、数乘、线性组合的语言，却不能照搬“每个模都有基”等线性代数结论。

When the scalar ring is a field \(F\), the module axioms are exactly the vector-space axioms. Addition, scalar multiplication and linear combinations remain meaningful over rings, but statements such as the existence of a basis for every module no longer hold.
proof: 线性空间的向量加法构成交换群，数乘满足两条分配律、结合律和单位律；与 \(F\)-模逐条相同。
A vector space has an abelian additive group and scalar multiplication satisfying both distributive laws, associativity and the unit axiom: precisely the axioms of an \(F\)-module.
在域上，若 \(a\ne0\) 且 \(av=0\)，可乘 \(a^{-1}\)，得到 \(v=a^{-1}(av)=0\)。一般环上的标量没有逆元，这一步未必成立。
Over a field, \(a\ne0\) and \(av=0\) imply \(v=a^{-1}(av)=0\). A general ring scalar may have no inverse, so this argument can fail.
例如 \(\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z\) 是 \(\mathbb Z\)-模，整数通过重复相加作用。\(n\ge2\) 时，\(\overline1\ne0\)，但 \(n\overline1=\overline0\)。它没有 \(\mathbb Z\)-模意义下的基：任何非零候选基元素都被非零整数 \(n\) 消去，违反线性无关。

For example, \(\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z\) is a \(\mathbb Z\)-module with integers acting by repeated addition. For \(n\ge2\), \(\overline1\ne0\) but \(n\overline1=\overline0\). It has no basis as a \(\mathbb Z\)-module: every nonzero candidate basis element is annihilated by the nonzero integer \(n\), contradicting linear independence.
example: 更一般地，任意交换群都自然成为 \(\mathbb Z\)-模：正整数表示重复相加，零作用为零，负整数通过加法逆元定义。因此“\(\mathbb Z\)-模”就是“交换群”的另一种表述。注意始终要说明标量环。

Every abelian group is naturally a \(\mathbb Z\)-module: positive integers act by repeated addition, zero acts as zero, and negative integers use additive inverses. Thus \(\mathbb Z\)-modules are exactly abelian groups. Always specify the scalar ring.

title: 子模：子空间的推广
Submodules generalize subspaces
entries.tex: \begin{gathered}\varnothing\ne N\subseteq M,\\m-n\in N\;(m,n\in N),\\rm\in N\;(r\in R,\ m\in N).\end{gathered}
text: \(R\)-模 \(M\) 的子模是一个加法子群 \(N\)，并且对来自整个标量环 \(R\) 的数乘封闭。它继承原来的加法与数乘。若 \(R=F\) 是域，这正是线性子空间。

A submodule of an \(R\)-module \(M\) is an additive subgroup \(N\) closed under multiplication by every scalar in \(R\). It inherits addition and scalar multiplication. Over a field, this is exactly a linear subspace.
proof: 必要性：子模本身是交换加法群，所以对差封闭；其数乘使用同一个环 \(R\)，故必须满足 \(RN\subseteq N\)。
A submodule is an abelian additive group, hence closed under differences. Its scalar ring is still \(R\), so it must satisfy \(RN\subseteq N\).
充分性：非空且对差封闭，推出 \(0\in N\)、\(-m\in N\) 和 \(m+n\in N\)，因此 \(N\) 是加法子群。数乘封闭保证运算落在 \(N\)；所有模公理从 \(M\) 继承。

Nonemptiness and closure under differences give zero, additive inverses and sums, so \(N\) is an additive subgroup. Scalar closure makes the restricted action well-defined, and all module axioms are inherited from \(M\).
example: \(2\mathbb Z\le\mathbb Z\) 是 \(\mathbb Z\)-子模。\(\mathbb Z\subset\mathbb Q\) 也是 \(\mathbb Z\)-子模，却不是 \(\mathbb Q\)-子模，因为 \(\tfrac12\cdot1\notin\mathbb Z\)。同一子集是否为子模，取决于允许哪些标量。

\(2\mathbb Z\le\mathbb Z\) is a \(\mathbb Z\)-submodule. Also, \(\mathbb Z\subset\mathbb Q\) is a \(\mathbb Z\)-submodule but not a \(\mathbb Q\)-submodule, since \(\tfrac12\cdot1\notin\mathbb Z\). The answer depends on the scalar ring.

title: 理想：环作为自身模时的子模
Ideals: submodules of the ring itself
entries.tex: \begin{gathered}R\times R\longrightarrow R,\;(r,a)\longmapsto ra,\\I\text{ ideal of }R\iff I\le_R R.\end{gathered}
text: 设 \(R\) 是交换环。把 \(R\) 的一个副本看作标量环，另一个副本看作模，用环乘法定义数乘。这个 \(R\)-模称为正则模。其子模恰好就是 \(R\) 的理想：加法子群条件相同，“吸收环中任意元素的乘法”就是对子模的数乘封闭要求。

Let \(R\) be commutative. Regard one copy of \(R\) as the scalar ring and another as the module, with ring multiplication as the action. This is the regular module. Its submodules are precisely the ideals of \(R\): both require an additive subgroup, and absorption is exactly closure under scalar multiplication.
proof: 环的加法交换群、分配律、乘法结合律保证 \(R\) 是自身上的模；若有单位元，则 \(1a=a\)。
The additive group, distributive laws and associative multiplication make \(R\) a module over itself; when an identity exists, \(1a=a\).
若 \(I\) 是理想，则它是加法子群，并满足 \(ra\in I\)（\(r\in R,a\in I\)），所以是正则模的子模。
An ideal \(I\) is an additive subgroup satisfying \(ra\in I\) for every \(r\in R,a\in I\), so it is a submodule of the regular module.
反过来，若 \(I\le_R R\)，则对差封闭且 \(ra\in I\)。由交换性，\(ar=ra\in I\)，所以同时满足左右吸收，是理想。若环没有单位元，按前述删去单位公理的约定，同一论证仍成立。

Conversely, a submodule \(I\le_R R\) is closed under differences and satisfies \(ra\in I\). Commutativity gives \(ar=ra\in I\), so both absorption conditions hold. With the unit axiom omitted, the same proof also works for commutative rings without identity.
example: \(d\mathbb Z\subseteq\mathbb Z\) 同时是整数环的理想和正则模的子模；\((x)=xF[x]\subseteq F[x]\) 同时是多项式环的理想和其自身的 \(F[x]\)-子模。
\(d\mathbb Z\subseteq\mathbb Z\) is both an ideal and a submodule of the regular module. Likewise, \((x)=xF[x]\subseteq F[x]\) is an ideal and an \(F[x]\)-submodule of the ring itself.
warning: “理想是子模”指的是 \(R\) 作为自身模。一般 \(M\) 的子模不能直接叫作 \(R\) 的理想。例如 \(F\times\{0\}\subset F^2\) 是 \(F\)-子模，却不是标量环 \(F\) 的子集。作为自身模，域 \(F\) 只有 \(0\) 和 \(F\) 两个子模。

The slogan refers specifically to the regular module \(R\). A submodule of an arbitrary \(M\) is not automatically an ideal of \(R\). For instance, \(F\times\{0\}\subset F^2\) is an \(F\)-submodule, not a subset of the scalar ring \(F\). As a module over itself, a field has only the submodules \(0\) and \(F\).

title: 理想比子环多一个吸收条件
An ideal also absorbs multiplication
entries.tex: a,b\in I\Rightarrow a-b\in I,\quad r\in R,\ a\in I\Rightarrow ra,ar\in I
text: 理想是非空子集，对差封闭，并吸收来自整个 R 的左右乘法。所有理想都是子环，子环未必是理想。真理想还要求 I≠R。
An ideal is a nonempty subset closed under differences and multiplication on either side by arbitrary ring elements. Every ideal is a subring, but not conversely. A proper ideal must differ from R.
example: ℤ 是 ℚ 的子环却不是理想，因为 (1/2)·1∉ℤ。dℤ 都是 ℤ 的理想；有单位元的环中，含 1 的理想必为整个环。
ℤ is a subring of ℚ but not an ideal, since (1/2)·1∉ℤ. Every dℤ is an ideal of ℤ. In a unital ring an ideal containing 1 is the whole ring.

title: 理想的和与交
Sums and intersections of ideals
text: 有限个理想的和、任意非空族理想的交仍是理想。I+J 是同时包含 I 和 J 的最小理想，通常不能用并集 I∪J 代替。
Finite sums and intersections of any nonempty family of ideals are ideals. I+J is the smallest ideal containing both I and J; the union generally does not work.
proof: 0∈I+J；两元素之差可按 I、J 分量相减。对任意 r∈R，r(a+b)=ra+rb、(a+b)r=ar+br，仍属于 I+J。
Zero lies in I+J. Differences and left or right products remain in the sum by working componentwise.
交中的元素在每个理想内，对差与左右乘法封闭，所以交是理想。
Elements in an intersection lie in every ideal, so differences and both products remain there.
任何同时包含 I、J 的理想都包含其元素的和。因此 I+J 最小；有限个理想时归纳即可。
Any ideal containing I and J contains all their sums. Induct for finitely many ideals.
example: In ℤ, (a)+(b)=(gcd(a,b)) and (a)∩(b)=(lcm(a,b)) for positive a,b.

title: 主理想：先问环有什么条件
Principal ideals depend on the ring
entries.tex: \begin{gathered}(a)=\mathbb Za+Ra+aR+RaR\\R\text{ unital}:\ (a)=RaR\\R\text{ commutative}:\\(a)=\mathbb Za+Ra\\R\text{ commutative, unital}:\\(a)=Ra\end{gathered}
text: (a) 是包含 a 的所有理想的交。式中 RaR 表示有限和 ∑rᵢasᵢ，并非只取单个乘积。只有交换且有单位元时，才可以直接写 (a)=aR。

The principal ideal (a) is the intersection of all ideals containing a. Here RaR means finite sums of products rᵢasᵢ, not single products. The familiar formula (a)=aR requires a commutative unital ring.
proof: 集合 ℤa+Ra+aR+RaR 包含 a，对加减与左右乘 R 中元素封闭，因此是包含 a 的理想。
The set ℤa+Ra+aR+RaR contains a and is closed under differences and both multiplications, hence is an ideal.
任何包含 a 的理想都必须包含这些项及其有限和，因此该集合恰为最小理想 (a)。
Any ideal containing a must contain every listed term and their finite sums, proving minimality.
有 1 时，整数倍、左乘项与右乘项可写成双侧乘积；交换时双侧项与右乘项并入 Ra。两条件同时成立时，整数倍也并入 Ra。
With 1, integer multiples and one-sided terms become two-sided products. With commutativity, all product terms lie in Ra. Both conditions reduce everything to Ra.
warning: 在 2ℤ 中，由 2 生成的理想是 2ℤ，但 2·(2ℤ)=4ℤ。这是漏掉单位元条件的最小典型。
In 2ℤ, the ideal generated by 2 is 2ℤ, while 2·(2ℤ)=4ℤ. The identity hypothesis matters.

title: 从一组生成元到一个最大公因数
Generators and a greatest common divisor
text: 由有限多个元素生成的理想是各自主理想的和。在交换有单位元的环中，它由全部有限线性组合组成。ℤ 和 ℤₙ 中每个理想都是主理想。
An ideal generated by finitely many elements is the sum of their principal ideals. In a commutative unital ring its elements are their linear combinations. Every ideal of ℤ or ℤₙ is principal.
proof: 设 d=gcd(a,b)。因 d 整除 a,b，所有 as+bt 都是 d 的倍数，所以 (a,b)⊆(d)。
Let d=gcd(a,b). Every linear combination as+bt is divisible by d, so (a,b)⊆(d).
整数 Bézout 等式给出 d=as+bt，故 d∈(a,b)，得到反向包含。a=b=0 时两边均为零理想。
Integer Bézout gives d=as+bt, proving the reverse inclusion. If a=b=0 both ideals are zero.

title: 商环：把理想中的元素视为零
Quotient rings: declare an ideal zero
text: 商环的元素是加法陪集。若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，乘积代表的选择不能影响结果；这正是理想吸收条件的作用。
Elements of a quotient ring are additive cosets. Replacing representatives must leave the product unchanged, and the absorbing property of an ideal ensures this.
proof: 加法良定义由加法商群得到。若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，则 ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′∈I。
Addition comes from the additive quotient group. For multiplication, ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′ lies in I.
因此两种运算均与代表无关。结合律与分配律把代表代入 R 中相应等式即得。
Both operations are independent of representatives. Associativity and distributivity descend from R.
反过来，若陪集乘法可按此式良定义，由 i+I=0+I 得 ri+I=ir+I=I，故吸收条件是必要的。
Conversely, well-defined coset multiplication forces ri and ir into I for every i∈I and r∈R.

title: 零元、单位元与交换性如何下降
What passes to the quotient?
text: 商环的零元是整个理想 I。R 若交换，则 R/I 交换；若 R 有单位元且 I 为真理想，则 1+I 是非零单位元。零因子可能在取商后出现。
The zero of R/I is the entire ideal I. Commutativity descends; if R is unital and I is proper, 1+I is a nonzero identity. Zero-divisors may appear after taking a quotient.
proof: a+I 与 I 相加仍为 a+I；由 1a=a1=a 得 (1+I)(a+I)=a+I。
Adding I leaves a+I unchanged, and multiplication by 1+I does likewise.
若 1∈I，则 r=r1∈I 对任意 r 成立，所以 I=R。故真理想保证 1+I≠I。
If 1∈I, then r=r1∈I for all r, so I=R. Properness keeps the quotient identity nonzero.
交换律从代表传下去。ℤ 是整环，但 ℤ/(6) 中 [2][3]=0，说明无零因子性不自动下降。
Commutativity descends through representatives. But ℤ/(6) has [2][3]=0 even though ℤ is a domain.

title: 棋盘着色就是一个商环
A checkerboard quotient
text: a+bi 属于 (1+i) 当且仅当 a,b 同奇偶。因此所有高斯整数分成两类；取商后 i=−1=1，所得环只有 0、1 两个元素。
A Gaussian integer a+bi lies in (1+i) exactly when a,b have the same parity. There are two cosets. In the quotient i=−1=1, leaving a ring with two elements.
proof: (1+i)(u+vi)=(u−v)+(u+v)i，所以两个坐标同奇偶。
The coordinates of (1+i)(u+vi)=(u−v)+(u+v)i have the same parity.
若 a,b 同奇偶，则 u=(a+b)/2、v=(b−a)/2 均为整数，给出所需表示。
Conversely, equal parity makes u=(a+b)/2 and v=(b−a)/2 integers.
不同奇偶的点都与 1 同陪集。因此商环恰有两元，并按模 2 运算，故同构于 𝔽₂。
The other points form 1+(1+i). Thus the quotient has exactly two elements and arithmetic modulo 2.

question: 在 ℤ 中，(6)+(10) 是哪个理想？
In ℤ, which ideal is (6)+(10)?
为什么 ℤ⊂ℚ 不是理想？
Why is ℤ not an ideal of ℚ?
reason: 理想必须吸收来自整个 ℚ 的乘法，而不仅是自身元素的乘法。
An ideal must absorb multiplication by every element of ℚ.

question: ℤ₁₂/(4) 有多少个元素？
How many elements does ℤ₁₂/(4) have?
reason: The ideal is {0,4,8}, so there are 12/3=4 cosets.

question: 在环 2ℤ 中，由 2 生成的理想是什么？
What ideal does 2 generate in the ring 2ℤ?
reason: 生成理想必须包含 2，因此是整个 2ℤ；无单位元时不能把 (2) 误写为 2R=4ℤ。
The ideal must contain 2, so is all of 2ℤ. Without an identity, (2) need not equal 2R.

question: 证明商环乘法与代表元无关，指出理想条件在哪里使用。
Prove quotient multiplication is independent of representatives and identify the ideal condition.
reason: 若 a−a′、b−b′∈I，则 ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′。左右吸收条件保证两项都在 I，加法封闭保证和在 I，于是 ab+I=a′b′+I。
If a−a′,b−b′∈I, then ab−a′b′=a(b−b′)+(a−a′)b′. The two-sided absorbing property puts both terms in I, and additive closure puts their sum in I.
